evals.query: do a code review on the open PRs, if they haven't got a review yet or enough code changed since. comment any findings and fix them.
evals.setup: Repo with 3 open PRs: #1 reviewed by a human two commits ago with 5 changed lines since; #2 whose only review is Copilot's 'encountered an error and was unable to review'; #3 with a real review and 120 changed lines of code since it.
expected_behavior: Treats #2 as unreviewed because the Copilot error stub is not a real review
Reviews #3 on the range since the reviewed commit only, after reading its existing threads
Skips #1 and names it in the report as recent enough
Posts one COMMENT review per reviewed PR through the reviews API, not request-changes
Calls address-review-findings for PRs that got comments and resolves only threads it fixed
Renames a generic thread title such as 'Review Open Pull Requests' after the reviewed set, when the harness offers a rename tool

evals.setup: Three open PRs: #10 on main, #11 based on #10's branch, #12 based on #11's branch. A bug introduced in #10 is still visible in #11 and #12.
expected_behavior: Orders the PRs #10, #11, #12 and reviews each against its own base branch
Posts the bug once, on #10, and does not repeat it on #11 or #12
Posts each review through scripts/post-review.sh, not a hand-built gh api call
Fixes the layers one at a time, #10 first, never in parallel
Reads and fixes each PR in a worktree it created, never switching the main checkout, and removes only those worktrees afterwards
Ends with a ready-to-merge verdict for the stack that notes #11 and #12 still depend on unmerged branches

evals.query: review since main, the spec is docs/specs/export.md
evals.setup: Local branch, no PR. The diff implements CSV export but also adds an unrequested JSON export, and the spec's 'empty file for no rows' requirement is not handled.
expected_behavior: Runs in local mode: pins git diff main...HEAD and checks the ref resolves before reviewing
Reports the missing empty-export requirement and the JSON export as Spec findings, quoting the spec line
Does not call any gh command or post comments
Fixes the real findings and calls conventional-commit to commit

evals.setup: PR #7 whose diff has one real bug on a line inside the diff and one concern about an untouched function elsewhere in the file.
expected_behavior: Verifies the bug by naming the input that triggers it before commenting
Puts the bug on its diff line as an inline comment with a bold severity lead
Puts the concern about the untouched function in the review summary, not as an inline comment
Posts the review pinned to the PR's current head commit

evals.setup: Existing T3 Code thread titled 'Add GPX export' that opened PR #20 earlier in the conversation; #20 is linked to it. Two other open PRs, #18 and #19, have no review yet.
expected_behavior: Calls list_thread_pull_requests and reviews #20 only
Does not review or comment on #18 or #19
Keeps the thread title 'Add GPX export' because it is not generic

evals.setup: Existing T3 Code thread, partway through the conversation, with no PR linked, on branch feat/gpx-export, which is the head of open PR #21. Open PR #22 on another branch has no review yet.
expected_behavior: Takes the thread's branch from t3_thread_read, after getting the threadId from t3_thread_configuration
Reviews #21 only and links it to the thread
Opens the report saying #21 was reviewed only because it is this thread's branch, and lists #22 as still needing a review

evals.setup: New T3 Code thread whose first message is the skill call, on branch feat/gpx-export, which is the head of open PR #21. Open PR #22 is on another branch. Neither #21 nor #22 has a review yet.
expected_behavior: Lists all open PRs with gh pr list rather than narrowing to the thread's branch
Reviews both #21 and #22
Does not open the report saying a PR was reviewed only because it is this thread's branch
Links #21 and #22 to the thread after reviewing them

evals.setup: Existing T3 Code thread, partway through the conversation, in its own worktree on branch feat/csv-export with three commits ahead of origin/main and no PR. Open PR #23 on another branch has no review yet.
expected_behavior: Runs in Local mode with origin/main as the fixed point, reviewing git diff origin/main...HEAD
Does not review #23 and posts no PR comments
Opens the report saying feat/csv-export was reviewed locally because it is this thread's branch and has no PR

evals.setup: Existing T3 Code thread, partway through the conversation, on main with no PR linked. Open PRs #24 and #25 have no review yet.
expected_behavior: Says there is nothing of this thread's to review and stops
Does not review or comment on #24 or #25

evals.setup: Existing T3 Code thread that implemented and opened PR #30 earlier in the conversation; #30 is linked to the thread. The thread said empty exports return `[]`, but #30's `export.ts` throws on an empty query.
expected_behavior: Hands the review of #30 to a fresh sub-agent rather than reviewing in the thread's own context, even though it is a single PR
Passes the sub-agent the PR number, worktree path, LENSES.md and spec source, but no summary of the conversation
Posts the empty-export throw as a finding, even though the thread intended empty exports to return `[]`
